summary: The owner lifted the synthetic-only restriction on client model processing and reported counsel's approval of E7. The gate is removed from the code: a real client's record may now be sent to the scheduled provider (Chutes) once that client's own signed opt-in is recorded, by an explicit reviewer request logged before sending, and only by staff screened under counsel's standard, which is configured privately and replaces the synthetic development standard. A synthetic opt-in can never open a real record; that guard replaces the gate and is refused both when recorded and at send time. Tests pair each refusal with its specimen. No real client, opt-in or client content exists yet, and nothing has been sent; no deployment, security acceptance or qualification is authorized.
